piece.headline: HAALAND BLANKS AGAIN, ARORA STILL STANDS
piece.big_picture: Rajat Arora scored the worst week of his season, 32, and Neol did worse with 29. The lead went from 18 to 21. Sukrut sits third in the table. Nobody has made the leader pay for a bad week yet.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Krishna left 26 points on the bench, the week's biggest pile. A decent week sat unused. Bench Disaster fits.
piece.one_to_watch: Prathap and Kshiteesh are 1 point apart on the Top prizes line. One decent week could decide who holds the last place, and a blank could drop either out.

winners.name: Aditya
winners.verdict: Manager of the Week from 97th, and the table only moved 16 places. Climbing from that deep is a long road. A fine week, but nobody should call it a revival yet.

winners.name: Sandeepan
winners.verdict: 4 straight weeks below the league average, then a proper week. Tavernier did the job. That looks like a sharp transfer, not luck.

winners.name: Nihal
winners.verdict: Bench Boost was worth 11 points and Kinsky chipped in. Up to 15th, a well-timed chip.

losers.name: Monty
losers.verdict: The Doghouse is Monty's. Mbeumo and N.Jackson cost a 4-point hit and bought nothing back. The week's lowest score.

losers.name: Anuj
losers.verdict: 3 good weeks, then a collapse. The bench hoarded the points that mattered. A bad week, but the decent run before it still counts.
